articles.summary: Cpk, the process capability index, measures how well a stable process fits inside its specification limits. This guide covers the formula, a worked example, Cpk vs Ppk, what counts as a good Cpk, and why capability is harder to read for biologics.
articles.title: What is Cpk, and how do biologics teams use it?

articles.summary: OPC UA is the vendor-neutral standard bioprocess equipment uses to publish live process data. What it is, how it differs from OPC DA and MQTT, which bioreactors speak it, and how Invert uses it, with the other interfaces your systems expose, to bring every signal into one place as the run happens.
articles.title: What is OPC UA, and how do bioreactors use it?
